title: Proof Closure: the terminal meta-condition for an evidence-bound subject
subject_rule: Closure is relative to one exactly bound, unchanged subject.
halt_rule: All required predicates true for the same exact subject => HALT_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE
continuation_rule: Any required predicate false or any open obligation => CONTINUE_OR_BLOCK_BY_POLICY
mutation_rule: A changed subject creates a successor proof-closure question; predecessor closure remains historical evidence only.
non_claims: does not establish truth of unverified premises
does not solve the halting problem
does not prove all possible statements
does not transfer predecessor evidence to a successor
does not turn a formal closure result into empirical confirmation
